title: Refresh latest-version merge matrix
implementation: Diff final A03/A04 against recovery.3, SMS R4, storage R3, API r3, presentation.3, release r4, routing/import v1.2 and runner r3. Classify each path as retained, equivalent, merged or deliberately excluded with rationale.
acceptance: Updated path-level ledger; no blind whole-tree replacement.

title: Resolve shared runtime call-site overlap
implementation: Review OperationJournal, NativeRepository, ApiClient/CloudClient, BuriViewModel, workers, stores and installers together. Test stale generation plus uncertain outcome plus storage failure and restored screen in one integrated flow.
acceptance: Integrated tests preserve authentication, original IDs and financial-authority boundaries.

title: Implement trusted SMS checkpoint service
implementation: Implement independently rollback-resistant authenticated durable linearizable CAS with trusted-side transition rules; choose approved offline/unavailable semantics and real ownership authorization.
acceptance: Restoring both handset ciphertext and local data cannot rewind trusted state; concurrent writers and outage tests pass.

title: Implement encrypted offline intake and blob transactions
implementation: Build production CiphertextBlobPort and durable encrypted quarantine before checkpoint-dependent queue admission; retain original SMS while offline and during interrupted admission. Wire migration and worker fences explicitly.
acceptance: No SMS evidence loss or intake-cursor advance before durable retention; device power-interruption proof.

title: Implement legacy storage adoption and writer cutover
implementation: Decode actual product databases and sidecars; freeze old writers, retain complete evidence inventory, explicitly provision valid fresh keys/directories, and persist an irreversible writer handover gate.
acceptance: Original IDs, pending operations, tombstones and archived generations survive restart; old writers cannot restart.

title: Close storage anti-rollback and capacity policy
implementation: Provide trusted monotonic checkpoint for lifecycle history, establish bounded retention/compaction with durable archive readback and resolve unavailable-key/failed deletion policy without automatic reset.
acceptance: Valid-suffix truncation detected or safely blocked; approved retention and measured storage exhaustion behavior.

title: Wire recovery lifecycle scheduling deliberately
implementation: Choose lifecycle owner for opt-in read-only retry; use monotonic clock, shared namespace lock and cancellation. Decide whether durable/global rate limiting is needed. Qualify non-returning transport and restart without new mutation.
acceptance: Manual and scheduled GET recovery preserve original command; five-read local policy is not misrepresented as global durable limit.

title: Qualify actual HTTP framing and strict-version rollout
implementation: Exercise real platform/proxy headers, encoding, body deadlines, cleanup and cancellation. Coordinate strict client/server contract rollout; test rejected success responses as uncertain outcomes.
acceptance: No malformed acknowledgement admitted; compatible versions and actual timeout behavior measured.

title: Accept bounded positional restoration semantics
implementation: Confirm 16-page/2,000-row automatic restoration limits and changed-dataset behavior. Test busy observers, real list headers, process recreation, IME and localized fallback messages.
acceptance: Product accepts positional rather than guaranteed same-record restoration; installed accessibility/journeys pass.

title: Commission independent signing/provenance trust
implementation: Select protected real producer identities and policies outside candidate evidence; onboard signing, key custody, roles, threshold and revocation. Test r4 against final merged sources, not historical baselines.
acceptance: Independently authenticated evidence accepted; missing/revoked/wrong-role signatures rejected.

title: Triage historical credential-like findings
implementation: Review the 33 files flagged on release-r4 historical input trees by location and type without printing values; determine genuine, synthetic or superseded. Rotate genuine exposed credentials and rescan final source/dependencies.
acceptance: Every finding disposition evidenced; no assumption that 33 findings are 33 current leaked secrets.

title: Close exact missing-executor inventory
implementation: Reconcile A03.3 and unified-r3 plans; obtain missing exact packages/toolchains; bind any new dependency overlay and browser reference. Keep PGlite and real PostgreSQL results separate.
acceptance: All required current plan entries executed or explicitly excluded by documented scope decision; no inherited pass.

title: Execute MoU and governance particulars
implementation: Complete legal identities, mandates, delegation and Schedule 1 decision register; locate or obtain executed counterpart and evidence of required function-specific approvals.
acceptance: Authorised signatures and applicable conditions recorded; final document title alone is not execution.

title: Verify actual sandbox and regulatory authority
implementation: Inspect actual approval letters, permitted institution/product/population/term, amendments and reporting obligations. Verify continuation/transition dates and any outsourcing classification with qualified counsel.
acceptance: Written scope permits intended pilot; no inference from public framework, publicity or an application/report.

title: Approve one product terms and disclosure matrix
implementation: Reconcile RWF 1,000 contribution minimum, voluntary frequency, approved rates, pledged-only uplift, exit rules, hardship exceptions, charges and complaints across app, contracts, cards and reporting.
acceptance: BSM-approved bilingual version; no contradiction between any-amount claims, minimums or conditional credit promises.

title: Sign savings activation acceptance
implementation: Complete Schedule 7 savings criteria: product/account authority, BSM authoritative ledger, reconciliation/value dates, disclosures, privacy, support and full end-to-end tests.
acceptance: Dated savings activation certificate with attached evidence; source/test-tool completion is not sufficient.

title: Keep credit separately gated
implementation: Approve tariff, affordability, capacity, individual loan/pledge/debit mandates, security perfection/release/enforcement and any guarantee/insurance before enabling credit.
acceptance: Separate credit acceptance; savings can be evaluated without representing credit as active.

title: Approve privacy, retention and hosting controls
implementation: Document controller/processor responsibilities, DPIA/data flow, lawful access, hosting/transfers, retention, incident procedures and staff use restrictions. Keep financial-retention rules distinct from personal-app deletion.
acceptance: Approved policies and tested technical enforcement; no uncontrolled customer SMS in general AI accounts.

title: Fund and staff the operating model
implementation: Name operational, support, incident, reconciliation and backup owners; approve IKANISA-funded implementation/outreach budget and BSM financial responsibilities. Do not assume an unsigned interparty fee model.
acceptance: Funded budget, staffing/training, signed operating responsibility and contact matrix.

title: Gate outreach and reporting programme
implementation: Confirm four centres, local permissions, trained teams, approved printed cards, radio/influencer bookings and programme budget. Distinguish Jan 1,000-member ambition from authorised caps and actual results. Gate collection at outreach events on readiness.
acceptance: Verified venues/dates/permissions; measured report replaces targets; continuity plan before source-stated 5 February 2027 milestone subject to actual approval.
